'''Yabol Opa''' was a [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. A member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] since at least [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]], Yabol Opa allied itself with the planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] during its long [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|struggle]] against the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world, [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[University of Yabol Opa/Legends|University of Yabol Opa]] stretched across the entire surface of the planet, which had become a part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by [[17 BBY/Legends|five years]] later.

==Description==
Yabol Opa<ref name="TEA" /> was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CL" /> located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies']] [[Yabol Opa system/Legends|Yabol Opa system]]. It was situated between the [[Delle system/Legends|Delle]] and [[Ifmix system/Legends|Ifmix systems]] on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], which served as a dividing line between the regions known as the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. In addition, around [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]], [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] connected Yabol Opa to the [[Belnar system/Legends|Belnar]] and [[Perave system]]s. That set of smaller [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes persisted until the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] of [[3996 BBY]] but had ceased to exist by the onset of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] in [[3976 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
[[File:YabolOpaAlsakanConflicts-EGTW.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Yabol Opa sided with the planet Alsakan in its struggle against the Republic's capital world Coruscant.]]
[[Realspace/Legends|Space]] surrounding Yabol Opa was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[27,500 BBY]] and [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]], and the planet had become a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by 22,000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the [[First Alsakan Conflict|First]] through [[Fifth Alsakan Conflict]]s, which collectively spanned from approximately [[17,018 BBY]] until [[12,700 BBY]], Yabol Opa affiliated itself with the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] in the latter's [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|political struggle]] against the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world, [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and its allies.<ref name="EGTW" />

The Republic's [[Third Mid Rim Army|Third Sector Army]] was charged with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in Yabol Opa's vicinity during the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], and the planet had become a part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].<ref name="EGTW" /> As part of their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], at some point between [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] and [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of the Yabol Opa system|attacked]] and conquered the Yabol Opa [[Star system/Legends|system]], and it remained under the control of the invaders by 27 ABY.<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
When the Galactic Republic began to expand through the blazing of the Perlemian Trade Route in 25,000 BBY, Yabol Opa became a thriving world that was home to the great<ref name="TEA" /> [[University of Yabol Opa/Legends|University of Yabol Opa]].<ref name="CL" /> By 22 BBY,<ref name="22 BBY">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] establishes that the [[University of Yabol Opa/Legends|University of Yabol Opa]] already spanned the entire surface of Yabol Opa by the [[Time/Legends|time]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|pursued]] the fleeing [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. That pursuit is depicted in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], the events of which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> that [[University/Legends|establishment]] of higher education had grown to encompass the surface of the entire planet. The [[Grand Warden/Legends|Grand Warden]]&mdash;and the absolute ruler&mdash;of the University of Yabol Opa at that [[Time/Legends|time]] was [[Solokin Sakellar/Legends|Solokin Sakellar]], who maintained a [[Coruscant Lodge of Solokin Sakellar/Legends|skyscraper lodge]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] capital, Coruscant.<ref name="CL" /> The population of Yabol Opa around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] numbered between ten and one hundred million.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet-wide University of Yabol Opa was first mentioned in the [[2003]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'', authored by [[Simon Beecroft]].<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], identified the planet by its name and placed it in grid square M-9.<ref name="TEA" />
